AMENDMENT NO. 1 JUNE 2020 
TO 


IS 16046 (PART 1) : 2018 SECONDARY CELLS 
AND BATTERIES CONTAINING ALKALINE 
OR OTHER NON-ACID ELECTROLYTES — 
SAFETY REQUIREMENTS FOR PORTABLE 
SEALED SECONDARY CELLS, AND FOR 
BATTERIES MADE FROM THEM, FOR USE 
IN PORTABLE APPLICATIONS 


PART 1 NICKEL SYSTEMS 


(Second Revision ) 


(Second cover page, National foreword, Para 3) — Insert the following new 


para at the end: 


‘As given in IS 16047 (Part 3) : 2018/IEC 61960-3 : 2017, portable applications 
comprise hand-held equipment, transportable equipment and movable equipment. 
Examples of the main uses are shown below: 


(ETD 11) 


a) Hand-held equipment: smartphone, tablet PCs, audio/video players, and 
similar equipment; 


b 


wm 


Transportable equipment: notebook computers, CD players, and similar 
equipment; 


c) Movable equipment: 


wa 


1) 18 kg or less in mass and not fixed in place; or 


2) provided with wheels, castors, or other means to facilitate movement 
by an ordinary person as required to perform its intended use; 


3) power tools, power assisted cycles, business-use video cameras, and 
similar equipment. 
NOTES 
1 All applications using batteries whose nominal voltages are equal to or over the hazardous 
voltage of 60 V d.c. are excluded. 
2 EESS (Electrical Energy Storage Systems) and UPS, which use batteries over 500 Wh of 
electric energy are excluded. 


3 Self-propelled vehicles are excluded.’ 


Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
